body: FALAMAR, the charming pirate Sea-King, leader of the Lanun in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: human; male; in his late thirties; lean and graceful. Sun-bronzed skin, black hair in a short queue, a neat pointed black beard, lively dark eyes, a gold earring.
costume: a royal-blue captain's coat with gold braid over a white shirt with a lace jabot, a sea-blue sash with a cutlass hilt at his waist.
signature: His broad BLUE TRICORN HAT WITH A LONG WHITE PLUME is on his head or in his hand.
extra: He is always at his ease: a loose stance, weight on one hip, one corner of his mouth turned up as though at a private joke.

vibes.name: Charming Fleecer
vibes.line: Holding out a quill to the viewer with his right hand, his left pressing a trade contract flat on a barrel head, a stolen signet ring glinting on that hand; the smile that empties purses, eyes straight on the viewer; a sunlit quay at bright morning, the harbour sparkling behind.
vibes.wears: a merchant prince's finery: a cream silk doublet with gold buttons, a short turquoise cape over one shoulder, rings on every finger.

vibes.name: Proven Right
vibes.line: Snapping a brass spyglass shut against his chest with his left hand, his right raising a goblet of wine in a private toast to the distant shore, a smug smile, eyes still on the quay through the stern windows; his gilded stern cabin at noon, sunlight rippling off the water.
vibes.wears: cabin ease: an open-necked white linen shirt with full sleeves under an unbuttoned sea-green silk waistcoat, his coat thrown over a chair.

vibes.name: Plume and Cutlass
vibes.line: Sweeping off his plumed tricorn in a low courtly bow with his right hand, his left hand holding a rigging line for balance, the cutlass hilt at his hip, grinning up at the viewer; the deck at full sail, a windy bright afternoon, white sails and spray.
vibes.wears: boarding gear: a fitted black leather jerkin over a billowing white shirt, a wide crimson sash, high black sea boots.

vibes.name: Pirate Courtier
vibes.line: Lounging against a gilded pillar, popping a sugared fruit from the royal banquet into his mouth with one hand, a brimming goblet in the other, eyes sliding sideways to the stiff nobles, grinning; a royal ballroom at night, blazing chandeliers, warm gold light.
vibes.wears: his salt-stained royal-blue sea-coat with tarnished gold braid, a white lace jabot and sea boots still damp, plain among the nobles' silks.
